newsitem.title: UK: Bunker markets quiet ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Bunker markets quiet ahead of holiday.

text.p: Bunker fuel demand was low in Antwerp on Wednesday with average supply, while Rotterdam was virtually closed due to an official holiday, brokers said.
Most other centres were also quiet ahead of Labour Day holidays in much of Europe on Thursday, they added.
"There have been lots of preparations for the holiday with very little last minute business," one broker said.
Antwerp prices were down about $1 from Tuesday, with 380 cst bunker fuel at $83/85 per tonne and 180 cst at $88/90.
In Hamburg avails were tight for prompt delivery but there was little demand, with 380 cst edging up to $90/92 and 180 cst down $2 at $96/978.
Fos prices fell $2-3, with 380 cst at $91-94 and 180 cst at $98-101, while Augusta rose to $98-100 and $105-108, brokers said. Piraeus was little changed at $91-92 for 380 cst and $97-99 for 180 cst.
Algeciras firmed with quotes-related prices to $95-96 and $98-100 respectively, but avails were good, brokers said.
